breadcrumbs.name: RFID Shipping Labels — Automated Carton Identification For Dc Receiving & Last-mile Logistics

summary: RFID shipping labels embed a UHF RFID inlay into a standard 4×6 inch thermal shipping label — enabling automated carton-level identification at distribution centers, cross-docks and last-mile facilities. Print the human-readable address label and encode the RFID chip in a single pass on your existing RFID printer.
